notes.title: Playtest Update v0.5b
notes.content:
[u]Added[/u]

[list][*]Added 37 achievements in the journal
[/list]

[u]Changes[/u]

[list][*]Reworked the knockback of enemies to work more reliably and feel better
[*]The base damage of mines is now independent of the current class of the Captain
[*]It is now possible to interact with arena turret to open their description panel
[*]Improved the spawning animation of enemies
[/list]

[u]Fixes[/u][list]

[*]Fixed the current reloading state of arena turrets not being restored properly after loading a save
[*]Fixed softlock with enemies frozen after loading a game saved in the middle of a wave
[*]Fixed enemies having a brief janky movement right after being hit
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.5a
notes.content:
[b]Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed the interactive menu of the Captain's tower building not updating properly
[*]Added invisible walls to prevent enemies from going too far outside the arena
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Update v0.5
notes.content:
[b]Added[/b]

[list]
[*]Added Anomaly's modifiers (one pick after each boss, for a total of 4 during a run)
[*]Added option to disable meta-progression and play with all the content from the get-go
[*]Now playing a new music track during boss fights: [i]United We Fight[/i]
[*]Added 6 new regular enemies and 2 new bosses
[*]Added a short tutorial to explain the basics at the first run
[*]All enemies and bosses have new and better 3D models
[*]Added a journal with stats, achievements, and entries to unlock
[*]Modified audio options to have separate sliders for UI and gameplay sound effects
[*]Added short cutscenes at bosses' spawn and death 
[/list]
[b]Changed[/b]

[list]
[*]Runs are now 26 waves long (including 5 bosses)
[*]Improved the attack patterns of the 3 already existing bosses
[*]Improved some sound effects for enemy shooting and waves
[*]Many improvements and polish to the UI and HUD (panel backgrounds, buttons, input icons, etc)
[*]Improved the visuals and sound effects of mines
[*]Mines now take more time to explode the longer they travel
[*]Tweaked the space backgrounds colors for further waves
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Update v0.4
notes.content:
[b]Added[/b]

[list]
[*]Added meta progression system with new meta resource to unlock buildings and leaders for future runs
[*]Added third leader: Fang (starting with the Samurai class)
[*]Added 9 new leader effects (3 of which replace old effects that were not quite useful)
[*]Added 4 new camp buildings
[*]Added 2 new music tracks (defeat + victory themes)
[/list]

[b]Changed[/b]

[list]
[*]Simplified the turret systems (only requires the Military Architect, no more research to do in the Research Lab)
[*]Zoomed the camera out a bit
[*]Increased a bit the arena size
[*]Increased range of all turrets by one
[*]Improved the end screen of runs with more statistics
[*]Added crystals orbiting the anomaly to convey how many bosses are remaining
[*]Tweaked the appearance of the Cannoneer and Crusher ship classes
[*]Improved the behavior of enemies:
[list]
[*]Enemies now target the troop members that attack them
[*]Bosses can perform a shockwave to repulse close entities
[*]Enemies get less stuck against the arena borders
[/list]
[*]Added clearer information to the Captain selection screen
[*]Improved the upgrade screen in the Training Center to show stats name
[*]Tweaked the space background by adding some planets and asteroids
[*]Tweaked the space background by shifting the theme color as the run progresses
[*]Added different styles to enemy bullets
[*]Upgraded engine to Godot 3.6
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*]Added more preloading to avoid lag spikes at the start of runs
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.3
notes.content:
[b]Added[/b]

[list][*]Possibility to build turrets within the arena through Turret building sites
[*]New building: Military architect
[*]6 new turrets
[*]New troop class: Samurai
[*]8 upgrade effects for the Samurai class
[*]New music track that plays after wave 11: [i]Around The Breach[/i][/list]

[b]Changed[/b]

[list][*]Some enemies now spawn at edges of the arena instead of all in the middle [/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.2f
notes.content:
[list][*]Added 12 new effects to classes (all classes now have at least 8)
[*]Reworked leaders portraits and added a starting effect to the Cannoneer leader
[*]Added a stat for troop targeting range that can be increased in the Training Center
[*]Reworked soundtrack + added a fade between peaceful / combat versions of the same track during gameplay
[*]Added the "Unique" tag to buildings description to inform when a building can exist only once
[*]Optimized space mines performances
[*]Fixed issue with game not properly paused when loading a save
[*]Fixed issue with camera not centered in fullscreen
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.2e
notes.content:
[u]v0.2e:[/u]

[list][*]Added a new leader to start with the cannoneer class (portrait is temporary and will be reworked later)
[*]Added a new effect for laser bullets
[*]Modified how knockback is handled to prevent enemies from escaping the arena
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.2d
notes.content:
[list][*]Added a new ship class: Saboteur
[*]Added 7 Academy effects for the Saboteur
[*]Changed dash to be unlimited outside of combat
[*]Added more tooltips to the HUD
[*]Changed enemies behavior to not go too far outside the arena
[*]Fixed HUD displaying incorrect camp size after upgrading buildings
[*]Fixed default input mapping (Up and Left were inverted)
[/list]
